summary: IgnisTrace solves a critical 25-year satellite data gap by harmonizing legacy MODIS and high-resolution VIIRS fire detections, eliminating artificial post-2012 spikes caused by sensor upgrades. Built for firefighters, land managers, and researchers, the platform features an interactive map for custom region selection and a multi-year burning activity calendar heatmap that instantly reveals seasonal peaks, drought years, and historical anomalies. By turning complex multi-decadal telemetry into seamless, bias-adjusted insights alongside one-click CSV data exports, IgnisTrace equips emergency responders with the reliable historical context they need before the next fire season hits.
